messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about HISTORY in German Reich (1871-1945) during the 1920s and 1930s?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: GESIS histat historical statistics Germany Weimar Republic 1920 1930 datasets
German Reich 1925 1933 census data dataset historical
Deutsche Digitale Bibliothek historical statistical yearbook German Reich 1930 data dataset
action.query: GESIS histat historical statistics Germany Weimar Republic 1920 1930 datasets

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"Election and Social Data of the Districts and Municipalities of the German Reich, 1920–1933 (GESIS ZA8013)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.8013","justification":"Highly relevant historical dataset covering the German Reich during the 1920s and early 1930s. Contains Reichstag election results from 1920 to 1933, population statistics, religious composition, occupational structure, and unemployment figures at district and municipal levels. Particularly valuable for studying political change, socioeconomic conditions, and the rise of National Socialism."},{"title":"German Weimar Republic Data, 1919–1933 (ICPSR 42)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.3886/ICPSR00042.v1","justification":"Comprehensive historical dataset covering electoral and demographic developments in Germany during the Weimar Republic. Includes Reichstag elections from 1920 to 1933, presidential elections in 1925 and 1932, national referendums, and demographic information from the 1925 German census. Useful for investigating voting behavior, political radicalization, and demographic changes."},{"title":"Voters and Elections in the Weimar Republic, 1920–1933","url_or_doi":"https://b2find.eudat.eu/dataset/16b742e1-8100-5fae-8a73-0b9dd981e8d8","justification":"Historical electoral dataset focusing on political participation and voting patterns during the Weimar Republic. Includes information about electoral constituencies, social structures, and selected election results between 1924 and 1933. Relevant for studying the development of German parliamentary democracy and the political transformations preceding Nazi rule."},{"title":"Historical Statistics of Germany (HISTAT)","url_or_doi":"https://histat.safe-frankfurt.de/index.php/en/index","justification":"Historical statistical database containing time-series data on Germany's economic, demographic, and social development. Its historical coverage includes the 1920s and 1930s, making it useful for studying inflation, unemployment, industrial development, population changes, and the economic consequences of the Great Depression. Provides access to downloadable historical statistical series."},{"title":"Historical Statistical Yearbooks of the German Reich (University of Mannheim Research Data Center)","url_or_doi":"https://www.bib.uni-mannheim.de/en/teaching-and-research/research-data-center-fdz/data-hosted-by-the-fdz/","justification":"Research data resource providing access to historical statistical yearbooks covering Germany from 1880 onward. Includes economic, demographic, social, and health statistics relevant to the German Reich during the 1920s and 1930s. Particularly useful for examining industrial production, employment, population development, public finances, and living conditions during the Weimar Republic and early Nazi period."},{"title":"Historical German Economic Development, 1820–1929 (GESIS ZA8084)","url_or_doi":"https://data.gesis.org/gesiskg/resource/ZA8084","justification":"Historical economic time-series dataset documenting Germany's economic development through 1929. Includes the 1920s and provides a longer historical perspective for analyzing economic conditions during the Weimar Republic. Useful for examining economic recovery, structural changes, and developments preceding the Great Depression."},{"title":"Money Supply, Prices, National Income and National Debt in Germany, Including the National Socialist Period (GESIS ZA8231)","url_or_doi":"https://data.gesis.org/gesiskg/resource/ZA8231","justification":"Historical economic statistics resource containing time-series data on monetary developments, prices, national income, and public debt. Includes coverage of the National Socialist period from 1933 to 1945. Relevant for researching economic policy, government financing, monetary conditions, and economic transformations in Germany during the 1930s."},{"title":"Historical Development of the German Financial System (GESIS ZA8230)","url_or_doi":"https://data.gesis.org/gesiskg/resource/ZA8230","justification":"Historical statistical dataset documenting the development of Germany's financial system over time. Provides economic and financial time series useful for analyzing the interwar German economy, banking and financial structures, and monetary developments. Relevant to research on financial instability and economic conditions during the Weimar Republic and the 1930s."},{"title":"German Reich Election and Social Statistics, 1920–1933 (GESIS Knowledge Graph ZA8013)","url_or_doi":"https://data.gesis.org/gesiskg/resource/ZA8013","justification":"Structured metadata record for the historical election and social statistics dataset compiled by Jürgen W. Falter and Dirk Hänisch. Identifies original sources including election statistics, unemployment statistics, population censuses, housing censuses, and occupational censuses. Particularly useful for identifying historical variables and tracing statistical sources concerning the German Reich between 1920 and 1933."},{"title":"Reichstag Elections in the Weimar Republic, 1919–1933 (German History in Documents and Images)","url_or_doi":"https://germanhistorydocs.org/en/weimar-germany-1918-1933/interactive-map-reichstag-elections-in-the-weimar-republic-1919-1933","justification":"Historical electoral data visualization covering German parliamentary elections between 1919 and 1933. Presents constituency-level election results through interactive maps, allowing researchers to examine regional voting patterns, party support, and changes in the political geography of the German Reich. Especially relevant for studying the electoral rise of the Nazi Party and the decline of Weimar democracy. This is a visual historical data resource rather than a conventional downloadable dataset."}]}
